The positive EBIT (777M) shows some operating profitability, but it is insufficient relative to the high total liabilities (39,015M), leading to a very high leverage position with total liabilities exceeding total assets. This combination of negative equity, weak liquidity, and poor solvency metrics places the issuer in the highest risk category, warranting a speculative grade deep within the "CCC" range due to substantial credit risk and default vulnerability.

DECISION: CCC-
